d:
This is my second time in Mongolia, and this time we’re back with an extreme challenge in the Gobi Desert! During my first visit, we almost died after running out of water in the middle of the desert. But this time, we’ve returned with a completely different plan and a challenge that will test our physical and mental strength.
In this video, we explain how our Gobi Desert challenge will work, the rules, and what we need to do to complete it. We’re mentally prepared for this extreme adventure, but the real question is: Who is going to win this challenge?
